name: Frog Love at Frog School
source:
Maria and Rowan are frogs who go to frog school.

They're girlfriends. Or are they? It's complicated.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210070444/https://juicy-luscious-jams.itch.io/frog-love-at-frog-school]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽亚与罗温是两只在青蛙学校上学的青蛙。

她们是女朋友。或者，也许不是？事情有点复杂。

（来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210070444/https://juicy-luscious-jams.itch.io/frog-love-at-frog-school]itch.io[/url]）
